forbidden_magic.book.food_modes: The shown recipe is for normal food settings. With gluttony=2, the Arcane Cake replaces its first egg and milk bucket with two Nether Star Blocks; the Ring of Nutrition replaces its diamond with one Nether Star Block. With gluttony=1, both recipes are disabled.
forbidden_magic.book.crystalwell_modes: The following recipes depend on the server research difficulty. The first uses a mixed crystal cluster and three balanced shards in normal mode. The second uses two balanced shards in easy mode. Only the recipe for the current world can be crafted.
